thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD#INC-768912 — helioedge-dedicated-reserved-pool latency spike (p95 > 2s) in us-east-1. Affects tenant: HelioEdge. Auto-paging #eng-oncall.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: notification delivered to alice_oncall; escalation to bob_sre in 5m if not acked.

alice_oncall: acked. Picking this up — triaging now. @bob_sre FYI you're on the escalation path.

bob_sre: joining. quick glance: reserved pool CPU 95%, queue depth x6 baseline, KV cache evictions high. grabbing metrics/dashboards.

paul_runtime: seeing a sudden spike in small real-time requests and a lot of cache churn. kvcache miss rate jumped ~40%, avg enqueue latency 1.8s. Possible model rotation or cache hotspot. Logs: 
```
2026-03-15T12:34:21Z [runtime] tenant=helioedge pool=reserved-helio-01 req_id=3a7c WARN kvcache eviction=1200 miss_rate=40% latency_ms=2400
2026-03-15T12:34:22Z [runtime] tenant=helioedge serve enqueue_timeout=true req_id=3a7d
2026-03-15T12:34:23Z [k8s] pod helio-pool-02 OOMKilled
```

tara_prodeng: any direct customer impact reported? Maya from CS oncall?

maya_cs: HelioEdge reporting 10-15% 5xxs and high tail latency for invoice grouping feature. They say it's widespread in us-east. Asking for ETA and mitigation.

alice_oncall: setting fallback routing to shared-hosted models now to stop errors. running command: 
```
rcli reroute --tenant helioedge --to shared-fallback --reason "reserved-pool latency spike"
```

paul_runtime: started reroute, monitoring. Also attempting to increase reserved pool target (if autoscale allowed) from 8 -> 12 nodes. Watching token rate and concurrency.

bob_sre: attempting manual remediation — one pod (helio-pool-02) OOM'd repeatedly. patching deployment to drain and restart pod, and bumping limits temporarily.
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/helio-reserved-pool -n redwood-tenant-helio
kubectl scale deployment/helio-reserved-pool --replicas=12 -n redwood-tenant-helio
```

incident-bot: Escalation: PD#INC-768912 -> assigned to bob_sre (escalation timeout exceeded).

alice_oncall: acknowledged. Declaring incident and notifying account team. @maya_cs please inform HelioEdge that we have a temporary fallback active, no data loss, just serving variant.

maya_cs: pinged HelioEdge; they acknowledged the fallback. Asking for ETA to full restore.

bob_sre: rolling restart in progress for pool pods, observed one bad kernel OOM pattern correlated with a model variant that causes higher memory. Restarting helio-pool-02 now. Will pin to older model if it reappears.

paul_runtime: pod restarted, KV cache warmup in progress. hit rate climbing: 18% -> 72% within 3m. p95 latency trending down: 2.4s -> 1.1s.

alice_oncall: good. keep fallback on for another 10m then shift traffic gradually. We'll keep monitoring and update HelioEdge.

incident-bot: Pager update: PD#INC-768912 status: acknowledged / investigating. Runbook: reserved-pool-latency -> restart unhealthy pods, reroute to fallback, scale reserved pool, monitor kvcache. If customer impact > 5m, generate postmortem.

alice_oncall: closing active page for now but leaving incident open and monitoring. I'll create a postmortem with timeline and remediation (pin offending model, add alert for kvcache-eviction rate). Thanks all :thumbsup:

bob_sre: noted. I'll follow up with a config change to prevent autoscaling down too far during model rotations.

paul_runtime: adding a short-lived mitigation: enforce per-tenant kvcache memory floor. Will open PR.

alice_oncall: summary for runbook: cause suspected model variant -> kvcache thrash -> OOM on one worker -> queue buildup -> high latency/errors. Mitigations applied: reroute to shared fallback, restart OOM pod, scaled reserved pool, warming cache. Next steps: postmortem, account outreach, model pin.

incident-bot: Incident PD#INC-768912 timeline recorded.

alice_oncall: closing thread here; will paste postmortem link when ready. Thanks team.
